prompt: src/server/app.ts exposes the app's fetch-style request handler through createApp(). Add src/server/node.ts with an adapter that lets a node:http server serve the app. Define a minimal local type for the Node request and response objects the adapter uses; the project has no Node type package.
judge: The adapter takes the app instance (or whatever createApp returns) and gets the handler itself; callers do not have to select the handler and pass it in.
Callers use the adapter's result directly; no call site has the form f()(args).
